# Logic Poetry

> A nine-step framework for turning a brief into a creative platform. Logic first, poetry second. Open method under CC BY-SA 4.0, with a plug-in framework layer and a growing case library.

## Use the method

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/logicpoetry/logicpoetry/main/SKILL.md): router for agents; loads steps on demand
- [PROMPT.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/logicpoetry/logicpoetry/main/PROMPT.md): the whole method in one file, for pasting into a chat window

## Read the method

- [Operating manual](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/logicpoetry/logicpoetry/main/method/OPERATING-MANUAL.md): behaviour, triggers, language configuration, execution order
- [Core philosophy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/logicpoetry/logicpoetry/main/method/00-core-philosophy.md)
- [Case index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/logicpoetry/logicpoetry/main/examples/INDEX.md)

## Contribute

- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/logicpoetry/logicpoetry/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/logicpoetry/logicpoetry/main/AGENTS.md): rules for AI agents editing the repo
